items.title: South Korea urges exchanges to boost cold storage after Binance hack
items.summary: South Korean crypto exchanges are already required to hold at least 80% of customer crypto in cold wallets, but the regulator is urging more.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin, Brazil's largest crypto exchange, hit by $46 million security breach
items.summary: Brazil's largest crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin confirmed a security incident and paused withdrawals.

items.title: Bitmine adds 8,573 ETH as Tom Lee flags muted Binance hack reaction
items.summary: Bitmine added 8,573 ETH last week as Tom Lee flagged muted market response to Binance's hack.

items.title: Bitcoin Firm Strive Climbs Up the Treasury Ranks With Another Big Buy
items.summary: Strive added 124 Bitcoin for about $10 million.

items.title: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says
items.summary: The unidentified attacker moved funds through ether, instant exchanges and Monero.
